app.name: Glassys
app.tagline: A chat face for local coding agents
setup.title: Create operator account
setup.body: Glassys always uses its own password, even if you put Access or another proxy in front.
login.title: Sign in
wizard.title: Set up this space
wizard.adapter.body: Pick the local CLI Glassys should face. Same UI protocol for every adapter. Changing adapter starts a new thread.
wizard.adapter.unavailable: This adapter is not available on this host.
wizard.adapters.failed: Could not load adapters. Check that the gateway is running.
wizard.adapters.empty: No adapters are registered on this gateway.
wizard.workspace.body: Absolute path on the host where the agent reads and writes files.
wizard.workspace.required: Enter an absolute workspace path on this host.
wizard.acp.commandRequired: ACP needs a command (or a registry pick) before you can enter chat.
wizard.cred.body: Use this host’s CLI or SDK login when possible. An API key is optional (Docker, CI, or an override).
wizard.cred.loginUrl: If a browser did not open on the gateway host, open this URL here (phone, SSH, or systemd without a display):
wizard.cred.loginTimeout: Sign-in timed out. Open the URL above or paste an API key.
wizard.cred.loginHint: Mints ~/.cursor/sdk/auth.json via Cursor.auth.login(). IDE app login and cursor-cli / cursor-agent are a different store. Optional env:
wizard.cred.keyConfigured: Optional API key is stored on the server
wizard.cred.signedOut: No Cursor SDK session on this host yet
wizard.cred.keyHint: Leave empty to use the CLI/SDK login or the matching environment variable.
wizard.cred.unsignedWarn: Sign in with the SDK or set an optional API key before entering chat.
wizard.cred.required: Cursor needs an SDK sign-in or an API key before you can enter chat. cursor-cli / IDE login is not enough.
wizard.model.body: Cursor, Claude, and OpenCode load models from the selected CLI’s live catalog. Gemini, Codex, and ACP use a static list; fallback is only a warning when a live catalog is expected.
wizard.model.empty: No models in the catalog yet.
boot.unreachable: The gateway is not reachable. Start it and retry.
wizard.model.required: Pick a model before entering chat.
wizard.model.fallback: Live catalog unavailable — showing adapter defaults. Sign in or check the API key.
wizard.rules.body: Which on-disk rule layers to load (Cursor). Default is project + user.
wizard.exec.body: With auto-run and a host workspace, this is operator access to that machine.
wizard.exec.danger: Cursor’s headless SDK cannot pause for your approval. Turning auto-run off uses Auto-review, which denies risky calls instead of asking. Sandbox off plus a public bind is dangerous.
wizard.exec.unattended: This adapter always runs tools unattended.
wizard.exec.permission.hint: Headless Claude Code cannot prompt you. Bypass runs tools unattended. Don’t-ask denies anything that would need a human OK.
wizard.acp.body: ACP speaks JSON-RPC on stdio. With auto-run on, Glassys applies file and terminal requests (no Apply/Reject UI). With auto-run off, writes and terminals are denied. Paste a command or pick a registry agent in Settings later.
chat.empty: Send a message to start this thread.
chat.sendFailed: Not connected — message was not sent.
chat.queuedHint: Send now to queue the next message.
thinking.label: Thinking
settings.title: Settings
settings.cred.fromEnv: This adapter’s API key comes from the environment. Rotating the stored key will not override it until that env var is unset.
settings.newThread: Changing adapter, workspace, or any agent option (sandbox, auto-run, rule sources, permission mode, ACP command) starts a new thread. Changing model applies on the next message.
protocol.incompatible: This PWA is not compatible with the gateway protocol.
